text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: I came to the shrine with Curren Bouquetd'or, who has been stuck in a persistent slump lately.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: Ah... No—it's nothing.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: Come—let us offer our prayers.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Clap, clap!)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The shrine visit concluded without incident.
However—

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: …………Ah, I knew it――

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
...Yes. This shrine has always been... a harmonious,
peaceful place—or at least, it should be.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: ...However, today, as you can see—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Prompted by those words, I look around to find
trash and broken tree branches scattered everywhere.
choice_data_list: Yeah, that's definitely something to be curious about.
Yeah, that certainly catches your eye.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: Most likely... it's because of the strong winds yesterday...

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
"...Um, Trainer.
Would it be all right... if we cleaned up the shrine grounds a bit
before heading home?"

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
"Leaving things like this
just hurts my conscience a bit..."
choice_data_list: You don't have to push yourself when you're not feeling well...

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
I'm sorry for making you worry...
However—

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: I'm sure everyone who visits the shrine comes seeking peace of mind... seeking harmony, I think...

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
Thinking about how much this sight might hurt
those people... I just couldn't leave it alone...
choice_data_list: ...All right. Let's finish this quickly together.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
Trainer... Thank you very much.
Please, lend me your strength—

text_block_list.name: Shinto Priest
text_block_list.text: Huh, clean the shrine grounds? We appreciate the thought, but we couldn't possibly trouble a visitor with that...

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
No—this is something I want to do myself...
So please, won't you let me do it?

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: To restore the shrine grounds to that beautiful, tidy state—

text_block_list.name: Shinto Priest
text_block_list.text:
...To be honest, we were really in a bind
due to being short-handed.
Please, we're counting on you.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
...Phew. I thought we picked up a lot, but—
it's in worse shape—than I expected.
choice_data_list: If only we had a few more hands...

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
Oh, Bouquet and Trainer!
What a coincidence bumping into you here.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
"Doesn't look like you two are here
to pray either, eh?"

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
“—I see, that does sound like Bouquet-chan.
Well then, let's get this
wrapped up quickly, shall we?”

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: Huh, Lala-san? B-But...

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
No need to hold back!
Friends helping each other out is just common sense!

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
Ai-san... Yes, well then,
I look forward to working with you—

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
...It's incredible. The shrine grounds were in such a state, but they're back to normal in the blink of an eye...
It's all thanks to everyone's help—
choice_data_list: Yeah, it feels great once it's all clean.
Yeah, it feels nice once everything's cleaned up.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: Indeed. Besides—

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
"It might just be my imagination, but I seem to be feeling better...
Is it thanks to exercising, or perhaps a blessing from God—
Fufu, I'd be happy if it were the latter."

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: We somehow—managed to finish, didn't we?

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: Ah—

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
Ah―― Yes. I'm sorry...
It's just that, I'm a bit tired, is all...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Although the shrine was cleaned up, Curren Bouquetd'or was utterly exhausted.
Her slump would continue for a while longer.
